urls.title: Spotify URLs
urls.description: Artist, album, track or playlist links (open.spotify.com/... or spotify:artist:...). Mix freely.

searchTerms.title: Search
searchTerms.description: Names to look up, e.g. Tems, Burna Boy. Each term returns the top match(es) of the type below.

includeDiscography.title: Artist discography
includeDiscography.description: For each artist, also return every album, single and compilation with each track's play count (one album row per release).

playlistTracks.title: Playlist tracks
playlistTracks.description: Return each track on a playlist as its own row, with position, date added and play count.

maxTracksPerPlaylist.title: Max tracks per playlist
maxTracksPerPlaylist.description: Stop after this many tracks on each playlist.
